# Ryukyu Rivalry JE
ryukyu_rivalry_coin_toss = {
	trigger = {
		OR = {
			c:CHI ?= this
			c:JAP ?= this
		}
        AND = {
            c:JAP ?= { has_modifier = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_officer_training }
            c:CHI ?= { has_modifier = modifier_ryukyu_rivalry_officer_training }
        }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = ryukyu_rivalry_training_incident }
	}
	effect = {
		set_global_variable = {
			name = ryukyu_rivalry_training_incident
			years = 5
		}
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				set_global_variable = {
					name = ryukyu_rivalry_fire
				}
			}
			1 = {
				set_global_variable = {
					name = ryukyu_rivalry_accident
				}
			}
			1 = {
				set_global_variable = {
					name = ryukyu_rivalry_brawl
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = { c:JAP ?= { trigger_event = { id = ryukyu_rivalry.6 days = 1 popup = yes } } } # Consider notification
		hidden_effect = { c:CHI ?= { trigger_event = { id = ryukyu_rivalry.6 days = 1 popup = yes } } } # Consider notification
	}
}
